Vendored browser libraries for SIGMA Explorer (served locally so the Explorer works offline and makes no third-party requests).

maplibre-gl.js, maplibre-gl.css  MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1 (npm "maplibre-gl@4.7.1", dist/), BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSE-maplibre-gl.txt
cytoscape.min.js                 Cytoscape.js 3.30.4 (npm "cytoscape@3.30.4", dist/), MIT, see LICENSE-cytoscape.txt

Only change from the npm files: the trailing sourceMappingURL comment was removed from maplibre-gl.js (the .map file is not shipped).
